system.description:
You deal +30 damage with your "Parado Riposte". A one-handed sword with a small triangular blade connected in multiple layers, forming a special shape. The blade can extend and retract at the user's will, allowing for sudden attacks. When retracted, it is the size of a normal one-handed sword, making it convenient for carrying.

Curse Pattern Crystal[Core Material](240G)+Broad Sword(330G)+Multisection Whip(220G)×2+[Magic Catalyst 12](150G)×4+Crafting Cost(640G)
